description: Crosspost watches a tweet.app account and reposts new posts to X automatically or after review, using each person's own X developer keys. Agent skills cover reading the docs and browsing public pages; posting and account actions are for people only.
name: crosspost

skills.description: Read the public setup, posting, tokens, security, and troubleshooting docs plus the changelog to understand how Crosspost works.
skills.name: read-docs

skills.description: Browse and index Crosspost's public informational pages (home, docs, licenses, changelog, privacy, terms).
skills.name: browse-pages
